|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The remaster limits the Used mode to one bounty hunter, and both retain two additional moves and free movement if escorting Han. The Lost mode now names the just-drawn qualifying weapon or Carbon-Freezing destiny. The later title has a printed dot that the 2004 slips and the [[:File:CC-D-hesallyoursbountyhunter-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher base]] lack. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=95 Period inherited restrictions on virtual cards].
